items.item: Replay trace evidence is now visible, but weak traces still read like diagnostics instead of a playable improvement contract.
items.recipe: Add a deterministic trace-evidence contract builder that translates weakness reasons into a next-run drill, then surface it in Run History trust recommendations.
items.evidence: src/utils/studioEventOps.js adds buildTraceEvidenceContract(); Run History trust recommendations surface the resulting proof drill.

items.item: The deterministic replay-resim milestone still has no local readiness meter; the game cannot tell whether recent evidence is strong enough to justify the next trust tier.
items.recipe: Extend Studio event trust summaries with a resim readiness status derived from rich/basic/weak trace counts and sync health; surface the status as a trust chip and recommendation line.
items.evidence: src/utils/studioEventOps.js adds buildReplayResimReadiness(); src/components/MenuPanels.jsx renders Trace basic and resim readiness trust chips.

items.item: Run Brain remains zero-token and useful, but it ignores the trust evidence loop that now exists in local Studio events.
items.recipe: Teach buildRunBrain() to prefer a trace-proof drill when the latest submitted run has weak evidence, keeping the advice local and zero-LLM.
items.evidence: src/utils/runBrain.js consumes latest trust trace evidence and prioritizes a replay-proof drill when the latest submitted run is weak.

validation.fullTests: npm test passed: 370/370 tests across 44 files.
